editorial:
If you like intense thrillers with real heart, this one grabs you fast. Olivia Wilde plays Sadie, a woman who survived brutal abuse and now helps other victims escape their dangerous partners. She trains hard, plans carefully, and shows up when no one else will. The movie feels raw and personal, like you are right there in the room with her. It is not a flashy action flick. Instead, it is a slow burn that builds tension through quiet moments and real emotion. You feel every punch and every tear.

Wilde gives a powerful performance that carries the whole film. The action scenes are rough and believable, not over the top. The pacing drags a little in the middle, and some scenes feel heavy, so it is not for everyone. Still, if you enjoy character driven thrillers, this is worth your time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final act, Sadie finally tracks down her abusive husband at a remote cabin. They fight brutally, and she kills him, ending years of terror. With her abuser gone, she is finally free. The last scenes show her moving forward, no longer living in fear, having avenged her son and reclaimed her own life at last.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves character-driven thrillers with strong female leads.
